name: Eval Dashboard, the two-batch Compare gate, the Agent Editor's Evals tab, and the finding card's eval-case affordance
description: S15 of docs/plans/eval-pipeline.md (REC-7). Entirely read-only: it makes NO POST, never presses 'Run eval', and never clicks 'Turn into eval case' — clicking any of those would mutate the freshly-seeded database (breaking the precondition flows 02/04/05 depend on) and 'Run eval' would additionally call a model, which no flow in this repo does (e2e/README.md; flow 08's own note 'no POST is made anywhere in this flow'). Everything asserted here is therefore seeded, not produced: S12 part 2 seeds 9 eval cases owned by the Security Reviewer plus TWO synthetic eval_runs batches ('baseline' at 2026-08-27 and a deliberately degraded prompt at 2026-08-28) whose metrics differ visibly and whose agent.system_prompt snapshots differ textually — which is what gives the Compare modal a real delta and a real prompt diff to render. The compare selection itself is client state only (React useState in EvalDashboardView), so ticking two checkboxes writes nothing. The dashboard's batch table lives on the per-agent drill-down, not the overview, so the flow clicks the agent row first. On PR #482 the flow expands two findings that are guaranteed NOT to be the auto-expanded first card (that is a CRITICAL; both of these are WARNING): 'N+1 query in user list endpoint' carries acceptedAt in the seed, so its 'Turn into eval case' button must be ENABLED, and '429 response omits Retry-After' carries neither acceptedAt nor dismissedAt, so the same button must be DISABLED and carry its reason in the title attribute (AC-3) — asserted with `wait --fn` against the button's own `disabled` property, scoped to the card by `data-finding-id`, because 'disabled' is not visible text. Assumes a freshly-seeded DB where acme/payments-api (PR #482) is the first repo — guaranteed by e2e-web.yml; run locally via the hermetic stack (see e2e/README.md).
